scope: Full-board validation readiness is an engineering review judgment, not a board failure probability. The historical nominal 9/10 behavioral score and 2.85/10 evidence heuristic retain their original meanings. Presentation and numerical scores assess only the delivered work within its declared models.

categories.label: Physical models and source identity
categories.note: Native connectivity, inventory and source hashes are retained. Dynamic models for 16 ICs, actual PMIC configuration and qualified passive/source/load models remain incomplete.

categories.label: Electrical limits and corners
categories.note: Thirty averaged rails, 13 retained campaign cases and four local transients are available. Real controller startup, stability, protection and worst-case loads remain unverified.

categories.label: Layout, SI, PI and electromagnetic fields
categories.note: Native geometry and local E/B calculations are available. Return-current distribution, high-speed channels and emissions/immunity remain unvalidated.

categories.label: Thermal evidence
categories.note: An L219 thermal RC illustration uses assumed thermal parameters and DCR loss only. Whole-board losses, heat spreading, airflow and measured temperatures are missing.

categories.label: Boot and functional startup
categories.note: Prerequisites and proposed timing are documented. Actual RK809-5 configuration, clocks, DDR training and executed boot evidence are unavailable.

categories.label: Bench correlation and qualification
categories.note: No physical electrical or temperature measurements, boot logs or calibrated EMI/EMC results are attached.

gates: Resolve critical operating-limit questions using exact parts, applicable limits and qualified load profiles.
Establish the actual power-tree, RK809-5 configuration, clocks, reset and DDR/firmware setup.
Complete applicable high-speed, return-current, power-integrity and thermal analyses.
Demonstrate repeatable physical boot and correlate measured rails, current and temperature with the models.
Obtain EMC evidence appropriate to the intended product and release claim.

online.label: Prepared · not run
online.note: The exact-part requirements form is prepared in the TI browser tab. TI requires the user to review and accept its terms before enabling View Design. This 2 A case is a declared comparison, not a verified maximum board load. No online controller simulation has run. Opening a new tab may reset the prepared inputs.

tools.name: TI WEBENCH
tools.note: Selected for exact TPS566242 support and low setup effort. Supported analyses and exact native-BOM matching must be checked after design creation.

tools.name: PSpice manufacturer model
tools.note: The official TPS566242 model is Cadence-encrypted. It cannot be run in LTspice/ngspice as supplied; its temperature, quiescent-current and other exclusions are recorded.

tools.name: SimScale
tools.role: Candidate for board cooling and heat transfer
tools.note: Requires qualified heat loads, materials, contacts and airflow. Documented low-frequency EM capability does not establish full-wave PCB EMC support.

tools.name: Ansys / Cadence cloud tools
tools.role: Candidates for SI, PI, full-wave EM and thermal coupling
tools.note: Assess HFSS/SIwave/Icepak or Clarity/Sigrity/Celsius against the required physics and available licenses. No jobs have been submitted.
